summary.intent: Pick up the michi work: bump Callisto from 0.12.0 to 0.17.0 on a branch, run its dry-run plan and `status --check --strict`, check for removed inputs and config tables that no longer load, and open a draft PR with the findings (not merging).
summary.outcome: Bumped the Callisto pin to 0.17.0 in the workflow, fixed a callisto.toml match that stopped applying to npm/michi-node, and verified strict status, dry-run and a lockstep version dry-run (all four packages to 0.9.1). The commit was being retried outside the sandbox after the pre-commit hook failed; the draft PR was not opened yet.

repo: The user's PR list was stale: #92 and #93-#97 were already merged and `gh pr list` showed no open PRs. The only red item on main was the Fuzz run, so the session state in the prompt should be verified before acting on it.
Callisto 0.17.0's release tag is annotated, so the tag object has to be dereferenced to get the commit SHA for pinning.
Under Callisto 0.17 the `npm/michi-node` match in callisto.toml stopped matching (strict status warned), so the npm rule needed a changed match.
The Callisto config and workflow have no `pending_pr_label`, `setup_git_user`, `[init]` or `[release.profiles]`, so the removed inputs and tables do not affect michi.
With no changesets, the release dry-run only reports 'Nothing to release'. A throwaway changeset (a patch bump moving all four packages to 0.9.1) showed the lockstep fixed group still works.
The pre-commit hook runs a moon format check that needs network and git config access, so it fails in the sandbox.

code.finding: Callisto 0.12.0 pins were updated to 0.17.0 (version and tag SHA).
The package match for npm/michi-node was adjusted so the npm rule still applies under Callisto 0.17.

workflow: The worktree guard rejects compound git/gh commands, so commands must be split into single plain `/usr/bin/git` or `gh` calls.
`gh` cannot verify TLS inside the sandbox (macOS keychain), so GitHub calls and the hook-running commit must be run outside the sandbox.
Download release binaries into fresh empty directories and extract them there, per the untrusted-download handling rules.
Exercise a dry-run with a temporary changeset when the real plan is empty, and delete the changeset afterward.

friction: Sandbox network blocks and TLS verification failures on `gh` forced several retries outside the sandbox.
The initial task state was out of date (PRs listed as open were merged), which cost investigation time.
Release-asset listing and binary download steps were each run twice, likely from sandbox failures.
The commit's pre-commit hook failed in the sandbox because of a git config lock and network access, so the commit needed a retry outside it.
Compound commands were rejected by the worktree guard and had to be split.
open_items: Open the DRAFT PR for the Callisto 0.17.0 bump with the findings, and do not merge it; confirm the commit succeeded first.
Investigate the Fuzz failure on main (build failure root cause was being traced).
Do the Entire hooks update as a separate PR and track both under trails; examine how the repo uses Entire trails and why 'Entire Gates' fails on dependabot PRs.

CI tidy (delete 'Bench (build only)', run Deny weekly, merge the two small toolchain jobs), making checks required in the `main` ruleset, and pinning an exact Node version in .prototools are awaiting user OK.
Run `cargo mutants` on michi-core (1,140 mutants) and michi-pipeline (517), close real gaps, and put exclusions with reasons in .cargo/mutants.toml.
User decisions are still open: the `Format::{Toon, Json}` option, ADR 0009, module renames and public tuple fields; small-model TOON accuracy runs need approval before spending.
Decide whether GitHub releases should carry assets or attestations (0.9.0 has none).
PR #84 (release-receipt script) was proposed for closing; check its status.
